answer: Unique answer work ticket: at dawn the registrar publishes a seed and issues a challenge whose accepted answer must hit a hash target and contain no prior logged answer. The seed includes a yarrow-stalk draw and the requester's fresh nonce, so an answer cannot be copied to another identity. Any echo of a logged answer is rejected, forcing an attacker to spend one sequential work run per identity; CPU time and energy cost cannot be amortized across sybils.
